desc:
inserting a rocket into an RPG-7 rocket launcher; full sequence

recorded in 2024 with an SM-57. this one was interesting to create, i took the dust cover off of my airsoft AK and just kinda... jabbed it against the AK and it created these really nice hollow metal sounds that sounded vaguely like a rocket launcher being loaded to me. so i recorded multiple takes and layered them over each other and i think it turned out pretty good.

crediting me isn't required if you decide to use my sound, but it would be greatly appreciated if you do!
title: Inserting a rocket into an RPG-7 rocket launcher; full sequence
